definition: Fault injection deliberately disrupts resources to observe how a workload responds.
An experiment template is the reusable blueprint defining FIS actions, targets, stop conditions, and an experiment role.
A target is the set of AWS resources selected for a fault action.
The blast radius is the scope of resources affected by an experiment.
Steady state describes acceptable workload behavior using business or technical metrics.
A stop condition references a CloudWatch alarm that stops an experiment when its threshold is reached.
A post action restores prior resource state after a fault when that action supports recovery.
A safety lever stops experiments and prevents new experiment starts in an AWS account and Region.
Role chaining uses permissions from one IAM role to assume another IAM role.
The orchestrator account owns and manages a multi-account experiment and its template.
A target account contains resources that a multi-account experiment can affect.
An Availability Zone ID consistently identifies the same zone across AWS accounts.
An Amazon Resource Name identifies a specific AWS resource.
A trust policy defines who may assume an IAM role.
Metric Math combines CloudWatch metrics into expressions that can support an experiment stop alarm.
